evidence_item.description: Jacob separates animals and the narrative distinguishes stronger from weaker offspring before reporting growing flocks, servants, camels, and donkeys. Any plausible selective husbandry strategy is distinct from the peeled-rod imagery and the prosperity attribution.
evidence_item.confidence_rationale: Narrated details are stated directly; historical, lexical, comparative, and theological conclusions are bounded and attributed. Ancient parallels contextualize but do not independently verify patriarchal events.
